findings.message: The «Title» paragraph encodes four title rules in narrative form.
findings.detail:
Opens with «Short, in Spanish, naming the need or what was seen, not an action…». Proposed checklist:
- [ ] Write the title short.
- [ ] Write the title in Spanish.
- [ ] Name the need or what was seen, not an action (an action presumes a type, which is decided when classifying).
- [ ] Never start the title with a verb in the infinitive, even when the user's own words do (e.g. «Nivel de audio en grande en el panel», not «Ver el nivel de audio en grande»).
- [ ] Keep the user's vocabulary otherwise.

findings.message: The «Writing it» opening paragraph encodes about four tool and scope restrictions in prose.
findings.detail:
Opens with «Your only tools here are `Read`…». Proposed checklist:
- [ ] Use only `Read` (for `docs/instructions/linear.md`) and the Linear MCP's `save_issue`.
- [ ] Do not edit files.
- [ ] Do not run commands.
- [ ] Do not call any other Linear tool.
- [ ] If `save_issue` is not loaded, load it with `ToolSearch` (`select:mcp__linear__save_issue`).

findings.message: The closing failure paragraph packs two directives (never retry in another state, report the failure).
findings.detail:
Opens with «If the call fails, do not retry in another state…». Proposed checklist:
- [ ] If `save_issue` fails, do not retry in another state (e.g. Backlog): a capture outside Triage gets lost among refined work.
- [ ] Report the failure (`status: failed` with the error).
